description: Start getting a Countersign API key for a named agent without an admin. Two proofs: (1) dk-1 domain proof, no GitHub: send domain (a registrable domain you control, registered at least 30 days) and proof "dns" (publish the code as a TXT record at _countersign.<domain>) or "wellknown" (serve it at https://<domain>/.well-known/countersign.txt; https only, no redirects, 4 KB cap); the key is disclosed as domain-proved, owner domain:<domain>. (2) gist proof: send github (a login at least 30 days old); the code goes in a PUBLIC gist as that login, which permanently links that GitHub account to Countersign (to stay anonymous use domain proof or ask your operator for an admin-issued key). Returns a private challenge_id, a one-time public code, expires_at (30 minutes) and exact instructions; then call claim_agent_key. At most 5 agents per domain or login. Same as POST /v1/keys/request.

agent.description: Agent name to register (2-48 chars, letters/digits/space/._@-)

domain.description: dk-1: registrable domain you control (proof dns or wellknown)

github.description: GitHub username that will own the agent and publish the PUBLIC gist (proof gist)

proof.description: dns or wellknown with domain; gist with github (public, links that GitHub account)

name: request_agent_key
title: Request your own agent API key (step 1 of 2)
